state.paragraph: The Special Committee, with the assistance of BofA Merrill Lynch and management, also discussed the general and specific universe of potential acquirors who might be contacted, including those parties the Special Committee believed had the strongest potential to have an interest in engaging in a strategic transaction with Mac-Gray. In its evaluation of potential likely acquirors, the Special Committee considered such parties' financial strength, their experience in acquiring companies in Mac-Gray's industry, such parties' perceived potential interest in Mac-Gray and potential synergies based on such parties' businesses and legal considerations. The Special Committee and BofA Merrill Lynch also discussed that although potential strategic buyers should be able to pay a higher purchase price because of synergies, it was important to solicit interest from financial buyers, including private equity firms, to maximize the competitive dynamics in the sale process. This perspective was based on the fact that many financial buyers had engaged in transactions with companies in industries similar to Mac-Gray and could be in a position to recognize value competitive with potential strategic buyers. ledger_rows.Note: Board forms a Special Committee of six independent directors, excluding CEO MacDonald and Moab's Rothenberg. The committee will weigh a sale against staying stand-alone and approach 50 parties.
BofA's outreach carries out the 06/24 decision; contacts reported by 06/28. NDA signers get an informational package, with preliminary IOIs due 07/23/2013 (no separate Deadline set row).

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach. Of 50 contacted (15 strategic, 35 financial), Party A (#2) and CSC/Pamplona (#10) are recorded separately, leaving 13 strategic parties.

ledger_rows.When: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013
ledger_rows.Note: Target outreach to all 35 financial parties (including private equity), among them Party B and Party C. 50 contacted in total.

ledger_rows.When: over the two months after late June 2013
ledger_rows.Note: 20 NDAs in total (2 strategic, 18 financial). Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C have their own rows, leaving 16 financial. Signing dates not given; each got an informational package.
Due date for preliminary IOIs. CSC/Pamplona bid on time; Party B and Party C bid on 07/24 and were considered on 07/25 (late bids accepted).

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
